mainEntity.name: What does a complete brand identity package include?

acceptedAnswer.text: A complete brand identity package by Muhammed Sidhan includes primary and secondary logo marks, icon marks, full typography hierarchy, curated color palette with color codes (HEX, RGB, CMYK, Pantone), comprehensive brand guidelines manual, social media kit, and print-ready collateral.

A 9-grid Instagram campaign is a strategic visual overhaul of the top nine posts on an Instagram profile, designed to function as an interactive digital brochure that clearly communicates brand identity, core offerings, testimonials, and contact details.

mainEntity.name: Do you work with international clients outside of India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Muhammed Sidhan works with founders and businesses globally, with completed client projects across India, Qatar (Global Solution Catering), Indonesia (Zidhaf Kitchen), and Nigeria (MBG Integrated Farms).

mainEntity.name: What file formats are delivered upon project completion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clients receive complete industry-standard production files including editable vector masters (AI, EPS, SVG, PDF) and web-optimized raster formats (PNG with transparency, WebP, high-resolution JPEG) with full intellectual property ownership.
